title: Innovation Propels e.l.f's Beauty Success
summary: Developing new products and bringing them to market quickly has been an important ingredient in e.l.f. Beauty's rapid growth. On Bloomberg Chief Future Officer, CFO Mandy Fields tells Scarlet Fu how her finance team plays a key role in the company's innovation processes. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: e.l.f. Beauty Sees Skincare as Growth Engine
summary: While e.l.f. Beauty's roots are in color cosmetics, the company has recently focused on building its skincare portfolio: since 2022, its launched an in-house skincare line and acquired two other brands (most recently Hailey Bieber's Rhode for $1 billion in 2025). On Bloomberg Chief Future Officer, CFO Mandy Fields and CEO Tarang Amin discuss e.l.f.'s strategy with Scarlet Fu. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Chief Future Officer: Mandy Fields, e.l.f. Beauty
summary: Chief Financial Officers now play a critical role in shaping corporate strategy and positioning organizations to meet future challenges. This episode profiles e.l.f. Beauty CFO Mandy Fields, who has helped lead the cosmetics company to 30 consecutive quarters of net sales growth. Bolstered by the purchase of Hailey Bieber's Rhode brand, e.l.f. now sees skincare as a path to even stronger long-term success. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Iran Ready to Escalate War Trump Says Will End After US Election
summary: Iran is ready for a more intense war and will escalate counterstrikes if the US continues attacking its territory and infrastructure, according to a senior official. Bloomberg's Erik Wasson has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)
